name: A2A Health Agent
description: WCNP health intelligence agent. Answers natural language questions about Kubernetes namespaces, deployments, latency, and Prometheus metrics on WCNP clusters using live MCP tool integrations.

skills.name: WCNP Namespace Health
skills.description: Check the overall health of a WCNP namespace, including deployment rollout status, pod readiness, and recent events.
examples: Are all pods running in sre-tools?
Show me the rollout status for my namespace

skills.name: Latency Analysis
skills.description: Query Prometheus for latency metrics of a specific app or service, with support for time ranges and percentile breakdowns.
examples: What is the p99 latency of signal-api in the last hour?
Show me latency trends for act-engine-api today by hour
Is there a latency spike in hub-server-horizon?

skills.name: Deployment Information
skills.description: Retrieve details about a specific deployment, including replica counts, image versions, resource limits, and recent rollout history.
examples: How many replicas does signal-api have in useast-prod-az-006?
What image version is act-engine-api running?
When was the last deployment of hub-server-horizon?
